lists_sprint_goal_check.name: lists_sprint_goal_check
lists_sprint_goal_check.value: "lists"."sprint_goal" is null or "lists"."sprint_start_date" is not null

activity_entries_status_check.name: activity_entries_status_check
activity_entries_status_check.value: ("activity_entries"."kind" = 'status') = ("activity_entries"."status_from" is not null) and ("activity_entries"."kind" = 'status') = ("activity_entries"."status_to" is not null) and ("activity_entries"."status_from" is null or "activity_entries"."status_from" in ('triage', 'backlog', 'todo', 'progress', 'review', 'testing', 'waiting', 'blocked', 'done', 'cancelled')) and ("activity_entries"."status_to" is null or "activity_entries"."status_to" in ('triage', 'backlog', 'todo', 'progress', 'review', 'testing', 'waiting', 'blocked', 'done', 'cancelled'))

activity_entries_priority_check.name: activity_entries_priority_check
activity_entries_priority_check.value: ("activity_entries"."kind" = 'priority') = ("activity_entries"."priority_from" is not null) and ("activity_entries"."kind" = 'priority') = ("activity_entries"."priority_to" is not null) and ("activity_entries"."priority_from" is null or "activity_entries"."priority_from" in ('urgente', 'haute', 'moyenne', 'basse')) and ("activity_entries"."priority_to" is null or "activity_entries"."priority_to" in ('urgente', 'haute', 'moyenne', 'basse'))

activity_entries_due_check.name: activity_entries_due_check
activity_entries_due_check.value: case when "activity_entries"."kind" = 'due' then "activity_entries"."due_from" is not null or "activity_entries"."due_to" is not null else "activity_entries"."due_from" is null and "activity_entries"."due_to" is null end

activity_entries_assignee_check.name: activity_entries_assignee_check
activity_entries_assignee_check.value: ("activity_entries"."kind" = 'assign') = ("activity_entries"."assignee_user_id" is not null) and ("activity_entries"."kind" = 'assign') = ("activity_entries"."assignee_added" is not null)

tasks_schedule_check.name: tasks_schedule_check
tasks_schedule_check.value: "tasks"."start_date" is null or ("tasks"."due_date" is not null and "tasks"."start_date" <= "tasks"."due_date")
